added_failures_note: The source dispatch declares FENCE - SUITE (unarmed for this node): no test file lies in the node's write scope and manifest.md carries neither baseline_suite nor after_suite. Zero is the unarmed-suite convention, not a measured absence of regressions. The focused gate (check_orientation.py) and its transposed control were re-run independently by this review at the reviewed head: native shift 3.3980969751578525e-09 m at EXIT=0, transposed shift 0.3284652269144239 m at EXIT=1.

assertion_review.failure_condition: Revert flux_orientation.analysis_field to the shape-first branch (return the array unchanged when shape == (height, radius)): the 33x33 archive is then read untransposed, the archive-derived polish moves the independently recorded solver axis 0.328465227 m against an archive-derived 0.053125 m spacing, and the native CLI exits 1. Verified by running it: this review reproduced 3.3980969751578525e-09 m at EXIT=0 and 0.3284652269144239 m at EXIT=1.

Point a receipt at a run-scratch or absolute figure path: repository_relative(candidate) != pointer holds, the fault is printed and the CLI exits 1; refusal-controls.log records all three variants red. This is not a pass-through equality because candidate is resolved against the filesystem and the project's own path mapping.

Draw a text artist off the canvas, over another text artist, or across a contour: check_panel raises SystemExit naming the artist; panel-guard-controls.log records five controls, of which four are refusals (colliding, off-canvas x=[865,1453], 24 crossed segments, and a segment crossing between two outside endpoints).

Rasterise a panel whose solved lines fuse: fused pixel count above the threshold exits nonzero; legibility-negative-control.log records 7254 fused pixels and CHECK=1 on the reverted drawing against 5 on the reviewed head.

figure_review.result: Inspected the three rendered previews at the reviewed head. Frame 146 trip 1: nested solved contours around the reported axis inside the limiter, violet bounding surface closing in the midplane, both null sets drawn, the displaced X-point callout legible with its hollow true-position dot, residual column beside the panel with a fixed 0.05 step and two decimals. Frame 146 trip 2: the axis triangle sits above the limiter as the corrected record states, the crowded solved set is drawn thin, and no bounding-surface legend entry appears because none is drawn. Frame 137 trip 2: the axis is inside the core with contours nesting around it. No clipped or overlapping label observed; a legend entry is present for every mark drawn.

findings.text: The gate exercises analysis_field directly and never runs a reader, so a later edit that reinstates the shape-first branch inside polish_axis_check.py, maxima_census.py, core_stationary_probe.py or render_trip_panels.py passes every recorded check while silently re-transposing the field; the binding is guarded at the helper and not at its four call sites, and no suite test imports these modules.

analysis_field still consults the array shape and returns a height-major non-square map unchanged, so a future writer that emitted the reader order would be read without error rather than refused; the helper therefore prefers the declared order on ambiguity instead of binding to it as the brief asks.

item_verdicts.assertions: Read each added refusal point against the defect it claims to guard: the polish bound, the receipt pointer rule, the path-mapping lint, the canvas/text-overlap/label-over-data guard and the fused-pixel count are all measured against archive, filesystem or rendered-raster state rather than against a value the check itself supplied; none is a pass-through equality.
item_verdicts.call_sites: Examined the four production readers that can reach the change: polish_axis_check.py:check, maxima_census.py:census, core_stationary_probe's report, and render_trip_panels.py:render_trip; all four import analysis_field and none retains the shape-first branch (git grep at e138d27ca returns no _oriented).

item_verdicts.done_when: All three clauses are asserted: check_orientation.py:85 asserts the native polish displacement stays under one lattice spacing and its --transpose control goes red (both reproduced by this review); regenerated/regenerate.log and rendered receipts cover frame 146 trips 1-2 and frame 137 trips 1-2; the correction table at fragment:299 names each surviving and withdrawn claim with its source.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read manifest.md at status complete; it records native 3.4e-9 m and transposed 0.3284652 m with named logs, the regenerated receipts, three re-rendered panels, and per-rubric self-checks; its dispatch arms no baseline_suite/after_suite pair.

justifications.durability: check_orientation.py:85 reddens if flux_orientation.py:43 returns the untransposed square field, which the logged and independently reproduced transposed control shows, but nothing fails if one of the four readers reverts to a local shape guess because the gate never exercises a call site.
justifications.evidence: scripts/prototypes/diiid_vertical_loss/check_orientation.py:85 records the done_when's measure and orientation-gate.log/regenerated/regenerate.log carry the results, but the render and regeneration commands recorded in gate-round-six.log abbreviate their arguments as <run-dir>/<rows>, so those lines are not literally re-runnable.
justifications.fit: The four readers keep their existing spline, interpolator and media idioms and the new names carry no plan label, version or ticket reference, though render_trip_panels.py:58 imports the private _check_text_artists across a sibling prototype directory.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/diiid_vertical_loss/flux_orientation.py:39 replaces the shape guess the brief identifies, and the evidence fragment:299 keeps the withdrawn 0.328 m sentence in place and adds the corrected receipts beside it, which is what the goal asks for.
justifications.reuse: render_trip_panels.py:736 and check_panel_receipts.py:27 both route through nova.database.filepath.repository_relative and render_trip_panels.py:262 reuses the existing _check_text_artists owner; a search for a segment-versus-box or label-over-data owner in nova/ and scripts/prototypes/ found none (bank_drive_barrier/plot.py:44 tests a whole Path against a bbox, a different capability).
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path is under the three declared write paths, yet the diff also lands three ancillary checkers (check_contour_legibility.py, check_panel_receipts.py, check_path_mapping_reuse.py) and a formatter-only edit to trip_trajectory.py:156 that the orientation goal does not imply.
